item.description: Today Donald Trump maneuvered the lawyer who won his personal immunity case into the White House counsel's office, which represents the presidency. Will Scharf was one of Trump's personal lawyers who convinced the Supreme Court that presidents cannot be prosecuted for official acts. His reward comes two days after the Senate confirmed Todd Blanche, Trump's personal criminal defense lawyer from his hush money trial, as attorney general. Trump's personal defense team now runs the government's two most powerful legal offices. These jobs go to the people who pass the loyalty test, and the acceptable answer is written down now. Four judicial nominees testified on the Hill last week, and every one recited the same rehearsed script about the Electoral College rather than say who won the 2020 election. Senators narrowed the question to just the popular vote and got the script again. Blanche performed his version at his hearing, telling senators "I am the president's lawyer" before catching himself and saying "was." item.title: Imgur, I’m shattered
item.description:
This is Kuro. He was my soul kitty. My vicious beastie. My bubs.
This sweet princess was Emers. My fluffy diva. My babes.
This gentle, old soul was my Vesemir. My little man. My man man.
Kuro had to be on me at all times
No cup of water was safe around Vesemir
Emers gave love bites and wanted all the attention
He always wanted to lay his chin on my hand
There was a territory war to lay on my chest
My men, always laying on me
Pinning down my legs
She hated being picked up, but she would graciously allow me to on rare occasions
Such a beautiful princess
Such a sweet, old man
Kuro was always down to be the little spoon
Where the boys would retreat if I was moving around too much
He would let my hold his little murder mitt
They enjoyed trapped me, and no, Emers was not overweight. I promise that was almost all fur. She was the fluffiest
I miss you, and I will love you always my vicious beastie
My sweet, gentle Vesemir
And my fluffy princess Emers
I trusted the wrong person. She was my sister-in-law’s sister-in-law. She’s is a cat owner herself and used to volunteer for rescues. I reached out to friends and family, asking if someone would be willing to take in my cats temporarily, until I have a place to live. She volunteered. Everything was fine for about 2 months, I think. Time is hazy and vague to me right now. Then, suddenly, within a week and a half of each other, all three of my babies passed away under her care. Three cats that were in perfect health, spayed/neutered, vaccinated, indoor only, pampered and cared for with me, all gone. I feel sick. I’m struggling to sleep. I’m struggling to eat. I feel like I’m surviving on autopilot. I’m trying not to do anything to her that will get me in trouble, but I do have the contact information for a deputy I used to work with to help catch animal abusers. I just don’t understand, and I’m lost. I’m heartbroken. None of this makes sense to me
Red headed Monday tax. Happier days and the best copper bed head
As always, thanks for allowing me to scream into the void. If you feel compelled to help in any way, I’ve had this set up for a bit. Fees are lower than Go Fund Me. You can scan the QR code or click this link http://spot.fund/kdjgmljsc
